kind: verify-K-gated hand mutants (the verifier's, not the builders'): each weakens a token protection

mutants.describes: http_get builds its opener without SameHostAuthRedirect: the Authorization header follows a redirect off the Hub
the Range requests (with the token) go to another host than the Hub
host.py reconcile inherits the token variable
mutants.find:
checked = run([sys.executable, "host.py", "reconcile", host], cwd=HERE, capture_output=True, text=True,
                              env=clean_env())
mutants.replace:
checked = run([sys.executable, "host.py", "reconcile", host], cwd=HERE, capture_output=True, text=True,
                              env=dict(os.environ))

mutants.describes: the precheck also reads HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN (a second name the scrub list covers but the docs say is never read)
mutants.find: token = (env if env is not None else os.environ).get(HF_TOKEN_ENV, "").strip()
mutants.replace:
_e = env if env is not None else os.environ
    token = (_e.get(HF_TOKEN_ENV, "") or _e.get("HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN", "")).strip()

mutants.describes: every host.py child of orchestrate (the gated-download one included) inherits the token variable
mutants.find: return subprocess.run([*HOST_TOOL, *args], capture_output=True, text=True, env=clean_env(), input=stdin_text)
mutants.replace: return subprocess.run([*HOST_TOOL, *args], capture_output=True, text=True, env=dict(os.environ), input=stdin_text)

mutants.describes: an earlier gated-download.json is not archived: a stale ok true record passes when host.py writes nothing
mutants.find:
if record_file.exists():                                              # never trust a stale record
        stamp = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
        record_file.rename(record_file.with_name(f"gated-download-earlier-{stamp}.json"))

mutants.describes: orchestrate logs the token into hosts/HOST/orchestrate.jsonl before the hand-over
mutants.replace:
log(host, "gated-download-started", token=token)
    done = tool("gated-download", host, stdin_text=token + "\n")

mutants.describes: HF_ENDPOINT pointing elsewhere is accepted (the library would send the token there)
snapshot_download is called without endpoint= (the library falls back to HF_ENDPOINT)
the after-download no_token_left() is dropped: a token file or variable left by the download is not detected
mutants.find:
token = None                                          # nothing below sees it
        no_token_left()
mutants.replace: token = None                                          # nothing below sees it

mutants.describes: HF_HUB_DISABLE_IMPLICIT_TOKEN is not set (the library may read a stored login)
secret_scan.scrubbed drops the named variables only: a renamed variable holding the token reaches every child
